prompt: A photograph from a lens fixed at the top of a lamp post, looking down steeply at a suburban British street in flat overcast daylight. Brandon jogs along the pavement, small and foreshortened from above, in a loose grey tracksuit and with an easy, upright stride, his face turned forward and calm. In the road beside him an ambulance, bright yellow with a green and yellow chequered side stripe, a blue light bar on its roof and plain panels free of lettering, rolls slowly the same way he is running, and Sophie sits in the passenger window looking out at him with her brows drawn together and her mouth closed. Wet tarmac, a postbox and parked cars give washed-out, compressed colour. Thanks.
